_about: The improvement loop (evals/improve.py, docs/improvement-loop.md). Proposals are written from failures on the tuning benchmarks only. The held-out benchmarks are never read while writing a change: they only check that a kept change didn't make the kit worse elsewhere. Each kind of target is on both sides. web-hostile is held out so that no change is tuned to its planted instructions. smoke is a wiring check, in neither.
